{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates and ensure patient_id is unique
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", trial_df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id']).sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline:", (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())

# Check the distribution of site and arm
print("Site distribution:\n", trial_df['site'].value_counts())
print("Arm distribution:\n", trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is balanced across sites
print("Severity by site:\n", pd.crosstab(trial_df['site'], trial_df['severity']))"}
